column5: GROUP: **Across crates** | 10. **`Equatable` recognised by path string.** Two constants `EQUATABLE_TRAIT_PATH = "Equatable"`: `S02/preparation.rs:2895` and `S03/equality_and_exhaustiveness.rs:334` (checked by grep). Stage 02 synthesises the `equals` member; stage 03 validates and expands it.

GROUP: **Across crates** | 11. **Integer and boolean constant folding.** `BTE/const_evaluation.rs:1268-1332` (`i64`/`bool` only), `BTE/const_generic_expressions.rs:5448-5538` (carriers and policies), `S02/preparation_const_evaluation.rs:784` (`i128` + symbolic), `:1676` (`ConstFactValue`), `:44` and `:147` (anonymous rationals, same four operators twice), `S02/symbols.rs:1052` (`zero_fold`), `S04/body_cloning_and_rewriting.rs:3988-4005` (`closed_bool`: Boolean, And, Equal only). Eight folders with different operator sets.

GROUP: **Across crates** | 12. **A `where` fact of literal `0` or `false` makes a variant impossible.** `S02/preparation_generic_data.rs:2400-2414`, `S02/symbols.rs:1102`, `S03/equality_and_exhaustiveness.rs:1144-1158`.
GROUP: **Across crates** | 13. **Zero gate of a data type.** Set in `S02/symbols.rs:978-1048`; cleared in `BTE/const_evaluation.rs:1794-1807` (checked) by looking at the first variant only.

GROUP: **Across crates** | 14. **Target-machine family grouping.** `S02/preparation.rs:2186` (syntax; key includes package, module path, name), `S02/symbols.rs:4637` (resolved; same name, module, attached data, package), `S03/lowerer.rs:1184, 1362`, `S04/monomorphization.rs:3365`. "Implemented twice" is tested by target string at `S02/preparation.rs:2241` and again at `S02/symbols.rs:4680-4700`.

GROUP: **Across crates** | 15. **Fixed-array length closure.** `S02/preparation_const_evaluation.rs:5492` and `S02/preparation_type_equations.rs:1614` (near-copy plus a lexical branch). Unit 042 "suspected" the same-named hits in other crates; my grep finds a second definition, `typed-trees/src/access_views_and_commitments.rs:2103`, so there are two functions of that name (bodies not compared).

GROUP: **Across crates** | 16. **Structural equality of two expressions.** `S03/equality_and_exhaustiveness.rs:1726` and `typed-trees/src/values.rs:4006` (suspected by unit 044; my grep confirms the second definition exists; not read).
